notes.title: NEW TRAILER AT THE HORROR GAME AWARDS!
notes.notes:
The Horror Games Awards have officially begun! 

The COSMIC FEAR gameplay trailer is now live on Youtube! Check it out:  

[previewyoutube=3Dmw-oT-FCQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Cosmic Fear is a first-person horror experience, connected to The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube, blending Lovecraftian lore with alien horror.
You play as an investigator of paranormal events and ancient mysteries.
You've been delving into strange phenomena happening in different parts of the world, uncovering intriguing connections. Now, recent events in the nearby forests have captured your attention. You feel that these occurrences might be part of a larger, more sinister puzzle. As you turn your gaze to the stars, you can't help but wonder: what secrets lie hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos, waiting to be uncovered?

Wishlist and try the demo now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3533150/Cosmic_Fear_Demo/

My other games of the series:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

Stay in the loop—follow me on my socials for the latest updates! 🚀
Thank you all for the amazing support! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: COSMIC FEAR DEMO IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Dear Lovecraftian horror enthusiasts,

I am thrilled to announce the release of Cosmic Fear DEMO during this Lovecraftian Days Steam Event!

Check it out and share your feedback - I’d love to hear your initial thoughts! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3533150/Cosmic_Fear_Demo/

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]
Cosmic Fear is a story-driven first person horror adventure connected to the previous games The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube, which you can grab on sale right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/
The game blends atmospheric exploration, Lovecraftian horror, and stunning visuals to create an immersive experience. Dive into a world filled with a unique sense of dread and fear, navigating dangerous environments where every shadow holds a potential terror. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276538/c7e2f639436fc6c16665871734d04471c7f1098a.jpg[/img]
You play as an investigator of paranormal events and ancient mysteries. 
You've been delving into strange phenomena happening in different parts of the world, uncovering intriguing connections. Now, recent events in the nearby forests have captured your attention. You feel that these occurrences might be part of a larger, more sinister puzzle. As you turn your gaze to the stars, you can't help but wonder: what secrets lie hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos, waiting to be uncovered? 

Dive into a story filled with mystery and terror, drawn from the darkest corners of Lovecraft's mind.
Ready to face the unknown?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276538/f77fdc62735c60612cdf817202fbfbbe96a9174e.png[/img]
More news about Cosmic Fear are coming soon! Make sure to add the game to your WISHLIST and follow it here on Steam to always stay up to date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276538/fc861a3109cc8ec1b0eb312e376b6f4905e78501.jpg[/img]
While you get ready to step through the gates of insanity, follow me on social media for the latest updates, and subscribe to the [url=https://www.guzzoproductions.com/]newsletter [/url]to join the beta testing program.

notes.title: DEVLOG: COSMIC FEAR - PROGRESS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Welcome back to another devlog for my upcoming game, Cosmic Fear. I’m thrilled to share some exciting updates on the progress as I continue to bring this Lovecraftian horror adventure to life.

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]
I've been crafting new environments that will take you deeper into the unknown. 
The latest environments are inspired by some of the eeriest corners of the universe, blending Lovecraftian horror with breathtakingly beautiful yet haunting landscapes. I’m paying close attention to every detail, from the creepy soundscapes to the dynamic lighting effects, to ensure that each environment feels unique and contributes to the overall atmosphere of dread.

Here's a sneak peek at what I’ve been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276538/c7e2f639436fc6c16665871734d04471c7f1098a.jpg[/img]
I’m excited for you to explore these new areas and uncover the secrets they hold.

In addition to the world building, I’m also working on the save system:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276538/95a12baf238c0f385012891dbc0557980ffb4091.jpg[/img]

[b]Join me on Youtube![/b]

I’m often live on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@alessandroguzzo]Youtube channel[/url] where you can join me while I play games, as well as dive deep into game development discussions, share tips and tricks, and interact with you. It's a great way to stay connected, and I can't wait to see you there and chat with you all in real-time! 

[b]My previous games[/b]

Cosmic Fear is connected to my previous games: The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube. Don't miss them out!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: COSMIC FEAR Announced! Wishlist now!
notes.notes:
Exciting news, everyone! 
I'm thrilled to announce that the Steam page for my new game, Cosmic Fear, is now live! 
Make sure to WISHLIST the game and help grow our community by sharing this exciting news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306920/Cosmic_Fear/

[h3]Plot: [/h3]
Cosmic Fear is a disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure where you find yourself investigating on strange phenomena that occur in a nearby forest. This time the episodes are weirder than usual and it looks like you're not the only one who's keeping an eye on them. 

As a solo developer, this is a massive project that I've been working on for years after my second title The Alien Cube. 
I've transitioned from CryEngine to Unreal Engine 5, using the latest technologies to deliver cutting-edge graphics, an immersive atmosphere, and a deep, engaging story. 
Cosmic Fear expands the narrative of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/568930/The_Land_of_Pain/]The Land of Pain[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099220/The_Alien_Cube/]The Alien Cube[/url], introducing significant improvements and a broader, more immersive experience. 
The way the Lovecraftian theme was brought to life in my previous games was much appreciated, and with Cosmic Fear I'm confident this new adventure will captivate you even more. The dread and wonder of Lovecraft's universe will be more intense than ever. Each step you take will pull you further into the chilling depths of this cosmic horror experience. 

Help me reach more people! Every single share is crucial, and any help is greatly appreciated. 
I've also set up a newsletter on my website where you can sign up to receive the latest news and you’ll also have a chance to join the beta testing program. 

Thank you all for your amazing support!
